other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual artist
Applicant must have extraordinary contributions in the field of Art and culture
Applicant must have contributed in Goa for at least 5 years as a practising artist
Award will not be presented posthumously, except if death occurs after name recommendation
Age limit may be relaxed by up to 5 years in exceptional cases
benefits_summary: A memento, certificate of appreciation and a cash award of ₹25,000 per individual.
